title: KeepThatMusic - Updated
description: Stops Minecraft from interrupting music when switching worlds/servers or pausing the game.
body:
## Keep That Music - Updated

This is a NeoForge 1.21.1 port of **Keep That Music**, originally created for Fabric by DarkAndBlue.

### What it does

Keep That Music prevents Minecraft from unnecessarily stopping or replacing the currently playing background music during events such as:

- Dimension changes (for example Nether portals)
- Player respawn
- Reconnecting to a singleplayer world
- Pausing the game
- Returning to the title screen

Instead of abruptly cutting off the track, the music continues seamlessly.

This mod is fully client-side.

### Port Information

This version ports the Fabric 1.20.1 release to NeoForge 1.21.1.  
No gameplay changes were introduced beyond adapting the implementation to NeoForge and updated Minecraft internals.

### Credits

Original mod by **DarkAndBlue**  
Original project page: https://modrinth.com/mod/keepthatmusic

All credit for the original concept and implementation belongs to the original author.
